name: `show`: one function a sight
story: A sight holds one function at most. <here at="(a):118">Functions</here> and <here at="(b):126">the outermost functions and classes</here> are both <calls at="(a):118 (c):136">blocks found by their keywords</calls>, including <here at="(d):152">one opened above the range</here>. <here at="(e):89">The rule</here> refuses a sight with two.
